headline: Record 135,000 Shelter Pets Find Homes in 2026 Campaign
meta_description: The 2026 Clear The Shelters campaign found homes for over 135,000 animals while securing $480,000 in donations for participating facilities.
summary_short: More than 135,000 shelter and rescue animals found new homes through the 2026 Clear The Shelters campaign, with participating organizations receiving over $480,000.
body:
More than 135,000 shelter and rescue animals found new homes through the 2026 Clear The Shelters campaign—a milestone that reflects growing momentum in animal adoption nationwide.

The participating shelters and rescues received more than $480,000 in donations, resources that directly support their ongoing work caring for vulnerable animals. This latest campaign continues a tradition that has been making a real difference for years.

Since its launch in 2015, Clear The Shelters has helped countless animals transition from shelter life to permanent homes with families. Each adoption represents not just an empty kennel, but a second chance—and for adopters, the chance to welcome a loyal companion into their lives.
quick_facts: $480,000+ in donations to participating shelters and rescues
